name: Parayer
overview: Prayer is a powerful means of communion with God, grounded in faith and unity among believers. Jesus teaches that when two agree in prayer, God responds according to His will, demonstrating the effectiveness of united faith (Matthew 18:19). The believer is empowered through Christ to accomplish great works, and with God, nothing is impossible (John 14:12; Luke 1:37; Philippians 4:13). Patience and perseverance in prayer are essential as we await the Lord’s timing, trusting in His perfect provision and faithfulness (James 5:7).
